diagnosis.first_candidate_result: Fifteen widget tests and workspace checks passed, but native Alt+Space/Escape still left plain Right as a frame step. The menu exit correction was not reached.
diagnosis.trace_observation: The transparent controls popup opened its own system menu; the framed owner received no menu-enter, menu-exit or queued-restore messages. Its menu appeared offset below the actual window title bar. Temporary tracing was removed after diagnosis.
diagnosis.escape_clarification: A hidden popup does not imply WM_EXITMENULOOP. Native tracing showed that first Escape returns to menu-bar navigation; the second Escape ends the loop. Reopening with Space between those Escapes is normal Windows behavior, not evidence of duplicate entry. This behavior is preserved.
